top_signals.title: Ukrainian Drone Strike Kills 12 in Major Attack on Russian Refining Hub
top_signals.summary: A Ukrainian drone attack on a city in Russia’s Tatarstan region killed 12 people and wounded at least another 39 in a massive strike that also hit one of the most technologically advanced oil refineries in Russia. Radmir Belyayev, the mayor of the city of Nizhnekamsk, which hosts an oil refining hub with two refineries and a petrochemical plant, announced the death toll on Monday, following one of the deadliest attacks on Russian energy infrastructure since the beginning of the war four and a half years ago.
